_description: Roth conversion's marginal ordinary tax sources from Cash before Taxable — verifies the conversion-tax-sourcing extension with cash priority 0.
_rationale: $500k Traditional + $200k Cash + $0 Taxable. Conversion event of $100k in year 0. No spending, no other income. cashYieldRate 0 to isolate the sourcing test. Year 0: Trad pulls $100k for conversion; conversion ordinary tax ≈ $12-15k federal (single, 2026 brackets, no other income, std deduction). Without cash, that tax would be withheld from the conversion (Box 4 mechanic) since no Taxable. WITH cash, ctCash absorbs the entire marginal tax → rothConversionTaxFromCash > 0, rothConversionTaxWithheld = 0, full conversion lands in Roth. Florida (0% state), 0% growth.
name: Cash Funds Conversion Tax
